title: Stop seeking applause from people who only watch for your failures. They don’t see the weight of the cross you carry daily, nor the strength it takes to take just one more step up that hill.
paragraphs: Stop seeking applause from people who only watch for your failures. They don’t see the weight of the cross you carry daily, nor the strength it takes to take just one more step up that hill.
The world judges the stumble. God rewards the climb. Stop performing for the crowd and start focusing on the only audience that matters—an Audience of One.
📖 “Am I now seeking the approval of man, or of God? Or am I trying to please man? If I were still trying to please man, I would not be a servant of Christ.” — Galatians 1:10
🔥 Drop an "AMEN" if you are climbing for Him today! Your effort is seen.
👉 Follow @iamGospelWarrior for daily strength in the battle.
